title: A Canary in the AI Coal Mine: American Jews May Be Disproportionately Harmed by Intellectual Property Dispossession in Large Language Model Training
measurement_description: The paper measures the disproportionate intellectual property dispossession from Jewish Americans by analyzing their over-representation as authors in common Large Language Model training datasets. It estimates the degree to which content created by this ethnoreligious group is used for training without consent compared to their proportion of the U.S. population.
findings: American Jews are disproportionately harmed by current LLM training practices. Their authored content is over-represented in common training datasets by a factor of approximately 2x to 6.5x, leading to significant intellectual property dispossession and the potential for substantial, disproportionate economic harm to the Jewish American community.
